about.title: Engineering with Purpose
about.subtitle: I am driven by the intersection of sophisticated design and robust architecture. My core focus lies in architecting intuitive mobile ecosystems—particularly immersive educational platforms—while also engineering high-utility tools and interactive digital experiences.
about.card1Desc: Expertly crafted native and cross-platform applications, optimized for performance, scalability, and seamless user interaction.
about.card2Desc: Designing comprehensive language learning solutions with interactive quizzes, native audio, spaced repetition, and gamified progress tracking.
about.card3Desc: Building scalable backend APIs, web dashboards, and web automation tools using modern stacks like Vue, Nuxt, Laravel, and Node.js.

privacy.noticeText: This document outlines our baseline privacy practices. Because our portfolio includes diverse tools, certain applications may require specific data handling disclosures. For the most accurate information regarding a particular app's data usage, please refer to the "Data Safety" section on its official store listing page.
privacy.s1Item1: No personal data is collected, stored, or shared.
privacy.s1Item2: No login or registration is required.

privacy.s2Text: While many of our applications operate entirely offline, some may require internet connectivity for core features. Any such requirement, including the nature of the connection, is detailed within the app's technical specifications in the store listing.
